main_text.l: XII.
COSMOGRAPHIA.
I. COsmographia sacra est sphaerae mundi
scientia ex S. literis illustrata.
II. Sphaera mundi est systema constans ex
cœlo & terrâ. Hic itaque traduntur ea, quæ commu-
niter conveniunt globo cœlesti & terrestri.
III. In Sphærâ mundi considerantur cardi-
nes & circuli. De cardinibus aliquid invenitur in Scri-
ptura sacra: circuli sunt hypotheses artificum.
IV. Cardines mundi sunt quatuor: videlicet
oriens & occidens, septentrio & meridies.

l.i: Gen. 13. verf. 14. Psal. 107. verf. 3. Oriens est veluti
porta, per quam stellæ ingrediuntur in horizontem: oc-
cidens, per quem discedunt ex horizonte: Septentrio est car-
do, in quo locu habet polus superior: meridies, in quo infe-

main_text.l: rior. In Scriptura vocatur quatuor anguli terræ. Apoc. 7. v. 1.
c. 20. v. 8. Crebro fit illorum mentio: ut orientis sive or-
tus Gen. 11. v. 2. c. 12. v. 8. Exod. 27. v. 13. Ios. 16. 17. 18. Ezech.
Apoc. 21. v. 13. occidentis sive occasus Gen. 12. v. 8. c. 13. v. 14.

l.i: Exod. 27. v. 12. Ios. 11. v. 3. Ezech. 46. & 48. Zach. 14. verf. 4.

main_text.l: Matth. 24. v. 27. Luc. 13. v. 29. septentrionis Gen. 28. v. 14.
Iudic. 21. verf. 19. Ezech. 47. & 48. meridiei Gen. 12. verf. 9.
Exod. 27. v. 9. Deut. 1. v. 7. Ezech. 47. & 48. In quibusdam
locis iam citatis coniunguntur duo vel plures cardines.
Cæterum iuxta hos cardines numeratur longitudo & la-
titudo mundi: quæ duo coniunguntur Gen. 13. v. 17. Lon-
gitudo mundi numeratur ab oriente versus occidentem,
vel contra: latitudo, à septentrione versus meridiem, vel
vicißim.

page.notes: Line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are printed in the left margin and are marked as notes at their places. The woodcut-like initial C of paragraph I is joined to its word. Some Greek-style abbreviations and the final mark after "terrestri" and "vicißim" are read from a small scan and may be misprinted; "viciffim" is read as printed with ff, shown here as vicißim, which is a doubtful reading. The Scripture references are copied as printed and not checked against the Bible. The signature "H 2" and catchword "V. Cir-" stand at the foot of the page.
